text:
Ivy Park: quick sync thread - finalizing the QA + launch playbook for catalog lifecycle (onboard -> pin -> migrate -> retire). need tidy gates so CS/sales can commit timelines.
Diego Ramos: high level: gates should be machine-checkable where possible. avoid human blockers unless absolutely necessary.
Fiona Chen: agreed. propose 4 gate categories: perf, cost, quality, compatibility. each gate = metric + allowed delta + measurement harness.
Omar Ali: add safety & regression indicators too. for generative models we need a hallucination signal and a deterministic failure mode for tokenization breaks.
Nikki Sales: customers want a clear "if we opt-in, when are we moved" answer. can we provide a simple table: lane -> opt-in window -> expected cutover?
Ivy Park: yes. draft lanes: Concierge (0-21d w/ AM), Standard (22-60d self-serve), Extended (61-180d opt-in), Locked (contract-only, manual).
Diego Ramos: concrete numeric gates suggestion for Standard lane: perf_p95 <= 180ms (<=256 tokens), cost_delta <= +12%, intent_f1_drop <= 3.0%, hallucination_ratio <= 1.25x.
Fiona Chen: for Concierge tighten quality: f1_drop <= 1.5% and require human review sample of 50 items. also require deterministic eval harness run (same seed).
Omar Ali: preflight compatibility checks to run automatically:
- tokenizer checksum match
- kv-cache-schema == expected
- tokenizer decode/encode idempotency smoke
- model-param-count within 2% of expected
qa-bot: queued: run "catalog-onboard-preflight-v3" on ded-cluster-7, eta 4840000050
Nikki Sales: messaging ask: two templates: opt-in invite (timeline + incentives) and disruption FAQ (rollback link + contact). can marketing prep these? cc @elena-marketing
Ivy Park: yes. add migration incentive tiers: Concierge = 25% credits 45d, Standard = 10% credits 30d. legal needs to ok.
Diego Ramos: rollout config snippet for Console (so eng-console can wire it):
```
rollout_config:
  lanes:
    - name: Concierge
      initial_pct: 10
      duration_hours: 24
      monitors: [latency_p95, eval_delta, hallucination_ratio]
    - name: Standard
      initial_pct: 5
      ramp_to: 25
      duration_hours: 96
      monitors: [latency_p95, eval_delta]
  auto_rollback_triggers:
    - latency_p95 > baseline*1.2 for 10m
    - eval_delta > allowed
    - hallucination_ratio > 1.3
  fallback_model: family-x-compat-quant
```
Fiona Chen: add a mandatory human stop if tokenizer checksum mismatch detected. that's a non-automatable compatibility failure.
Omar Ali: telemetry: include tags: migration_lane, pinned_from, pinned_to, rollout_id, fallback_used. also capture pre/post eval snapshots to storage for audits.
qa-bot: run complete: median 107ms, p95 156ms, eval_f1_drop 1.8%, hallucination_ratio 1.05 -> PRELIGHT PASS for Standard lane
Nikki Sales: awesome. next owners: Fiona -> evaluation harness + human-review checklist; Diego -> console rollout json + fallback wiring; Ivy -> incentives + comm plan; Omar -> telemetry + storage hooks; Nikki -> sales playbook + customer templates.
Ivy Park: i'll file the runbook PR and link the templates. target merge by 4840000065. if all sign off i'll merge and schedule the first canary 09:00 PT tomorrow. keep updates in-thread :ok_hand:
